description:
16th October – Speaker Meeting – Display of Handmade Products with Heart – NGO: SEC

RCBP has been supporting SEC – Society for the Education of the Challenged for many years. SEC educates children with physical and multiple disabilities from the low economic sector upto 7th standard.

Our own club member Rtn PP Manju Uttamchandani runs the Integration and Inclusion program (I&IP) of SEC school.

Beautiful hand-made products created by skilled differently abled artisans were displayed during the Speaker Meeting on 16 Oct and members and partners bought several items.

The articles included diyas, paper bags, jar glass candle, small jar glass candle, matka candle, Diwali Ubtan, keychains, flowers, costers, medicine pouch, lemon pouch, potli bag, single flower keychains, single flower chains, double flower key chains, book marks, agarbattis, jute bags, cloth bags, medium pouches, small pouches and table mats.

This initiative supports skill development and promotes independence.
